name: ForeignExchange
description: From FpML: A type defining either a spot or forward FX transactions.

exchangedCurrency1.description: This is the first of the two currency flows that define a single leg of a standard foreign exchange transaction.

exchangedCurrency2.description: This is the second of the two currency flows that define a single leg of a standard foreign exchange transaction.

tenorPeriod.description: A tenor expressed as a period type and multiplier (e.g. 1D, 1Y, etc.)
